title: Solving the Elastic Wave Equation with Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Robust and Critical Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2609.07983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), offering a meshfree alternative that integrates physical principles into the learning process. This presents a new paradigm compared to traditional discretization methods and purely data-driven machine learning techniques. While promising, PINNs are not a panacea; they inherit challenges such as spectral bias and unstable convergence. Moreover, their potential in seismology remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide a robust and critical assessment of PINNs for solving the elastic wave equation in seismology. We investigate the performance of PINNs on problems with varying degrees of complexity across various seismic sources and parameter models, from constant to highly heterogeneous settings. translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）最近成为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一种有前景的方法，它提供了一种将物理原理融入学习过程的无网格替代方案。与传统离散化方法和纯数据驱动的机器学习技术相比，这代表了一种新的范式。尽管前景广阔，PINNs并非万能；它们继承了谱偏差和不稳定收敛等挑战。此外，它们在地震学中的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们对PINNs在地震学中求解弹性波方程进行了稳健且批判性的评估。我们研究了PINNs在各种震源和参数模型上、从恒定到高度异质设置等不同复杂度问题上的性能表现。我们工作的一个关键方面是研究是否直接嵌入物理原理（原文摘要被截断）……
tldr: 本文对物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在地震学弹性波方程求解中的应用进行了稳健且批判性的评估，系统考察了其在不同震源、参数模型及不同复杂度问题上的性能表现。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a robust and critical assessment of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for solving the elastic wave equation in seismology, systematically investigating their performance across various seismic sources, parameter models, and problems of varying complexity.
